cohort: The study included 534 children aged 7-12 years, comprising 383 preterm-born (<=34 weeks' gestation) and 151 term-born controls.
finding: Telomere length was associated with sex, intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR), and deprivation, especially in females with IUGR, but not with prematurity, bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD), lung function, or cardiovascular measurements.
gest_age: Preterm-born: mean 31.1 weeks (SD 2.6 weeks); Term-born: mean 39.8 weeks (SD 1.3 weeks)
